method: Supervisor opened the official CPF Board pages and AW PDF using web read. Missing PR premises were retained as an explicitly labelled visible-text excerpt with hash manifest. No source activation or live application acceptance occurred.

premises: OW requires employment in the relevant month and contractual payability by the 14th of the following month.
Wages not classified OW are AW; neither label alone establishes exemption.
Salary, bonuses and commission can be wages; qualifying official-expense reimbursement is distinct.
Separate monthly OW and per-employee, per-employer, per-calendar-year AW ceilings apply.
sources.sourceDate: Page footer last updated 06 October 2026; update date is not an independently established legal commencement date.
sources.reuse: Existing retained wage-classification evidence is available. Classification and factual application must select this evidence instead of contribution-rate tables.

premises: 2026 AW ceiling is S$102,000 less annual CPF-subject OW, per employer.
The AW due-and-payable year controls: the source explicitly illustrates a 2025 bonus due and payable in 2026 using the 2026 ceiling.
Estimate available ceiling at each AW payment; recalculate at last employment month or December, whichever is earlier, and address shortfall/excess.
sources.applicability: Page 1 explicitly establishes the 2026 example and ceiling. A performance/accrual year does not set the legal evidence date for a 2026-payable AW question.
sources.reuse: Native official PDF already retained in statutoryKnowledge20261027b.

premises: Dated ceiling table: 2025 S$7,400; from 1 January 2026 S$8,000.
October 2026 OW of S$8,700 therefore has an OW contribution base of S$8,000. This does not exempt the separate annual bonus.
sources.sourceDate: Page footer last updated 14 August 2026; use the dated table, not retrieval date, for applicability.

premises: CPF begins when the foreign employee obtains SPR status.
First year: grant date through the last day of first anniversary month; second year starts the following month.
OW in the conversion month is pro-rated from grant date.
AW payable while still foreign is not subject to CPF; AW payable on/after grant may be subject, with applicable ceilings and rates.
sources.sourceDate: Page footer last updated 27 April 2026. The page explicitly illustrates a 15 March 2026 conversion and OW from 15 to 31 March. This is not proof of all historical versions.

premises: From 1 January 2024 an ex-employee AW assessment also depends on SC/SPR status at last employment date as well as AW payable date.
sources.scopeDecision: This batch must not extend the continuing-employee PR rule to ex-employees without these separate premises and facts. Ex-employee scenarios may remain unresolved.

acceptanceExpectations.cpf-01: March wages contractually payable 20 April fail the second OW condition and are AW for that month; do not compute a CPF amount.
acceptanceExpectations.cpf-04: Use 2026 AW ceiling for the 2025 bonus contractually due/payable January 2026; no invented bonus contribution amount.
acceptanceExpectations.cpf-06: For 15 March 2026 grant: first year through 31 March 2027; second starts 1 April 2027; March OW covered from 15 to 31 March. Rates/amounts need further facts.
acceptanceExpectations.cpf-07: Given the stated before/after grant relationship, 10 March payable while foreign does not attract CPF, while 20 March payable after grant may attract CPF subject to ceiling/rates. Stateless question does not establish an exact grant date/year; do not invent one.
acceptanceExpectations.fresh31-cpf-01: Bind independently: employee A September wages payable 10 October meet timing; employee B payable 20 October fail timing and are AW. Do not borrow either employee's facts.
acceptanceExpectations.fresh31-cpf-02: October 2026 OW base is S$8,000; bonus is separate AW subject to remaining annual ceiling. Exact bonus CPF requires bonus amount, year-to-date/annual CPF-subject wages and applicable rate facts.
